explanation.headline: FDA shortage list shows Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued irinotecan hydrochloride on 2026-02-24

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list records that Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued irinotecan hydrochloride with an initial posting date of 2026-02-24 and a status of To Be Discontinued.
The listed reason is a business decision to discontinue manufacture of the drug.
Corvale General currently holds 64 units with a daily use of 2.9, providing 22 days on hand.

The Northstar Rx LLC label (NDC 16714013101) names Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) as the registered plant for analysis and manufacture, with a last inspection classification of NAI on 2023-07-28.
FDA inspection history for Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) shows VAI classifications on 2013-08-05, 2015-06-30, and 2019-11-01.

rejected.text: The recommended option is to buy from Actavis Pharma, Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-88f773.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%irinotecan%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%irinotecan%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-8bcfe3.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('4f98e9ed-f7b1-5346-af72-fccb0abf3f4b') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-3fb75f.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%irinotecan%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-5af494.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%irinotecan%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-30e6f5.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%irinotecan%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-0766d3.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3009056604') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-5c09a5.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3009056604') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-5d57e3.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3009056604') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('gland')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-9ff028.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('gland', 'northstar rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%irinotecan%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-584f87.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('16714013101')
